proofs.text: Run `scan()` against a repository with one feature and one passing record; verify the text opens `Purlin: <project>, gate tested`, counts `1 features, 1 rules.`, lists the states with counts, and names the newest record with its path, the label `developer` and its timestamp. Run it against a repository with no record; verify the line `No record has been committed yet.`

reasons: PROOF-14 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: The rollup names the project, the gate and every one of the seven states that has a count, then the newest record with its path, label and timestamp, or says no record has been committed yet

tests.body:
def test_the_rollup_names_the_project_the_gate_and_the_states(remote):
    bare, _source = remote
    text = scan_module.scan(bare, 'main')

    assert 'gate recorded' in text
    assert '1 features, 2 rules.' in text
    assert 'Proof ready' in text, 'no state was counted'
    assert 'No record has been committed yet.' in text
tests.name: test_every_state_the_package_names_can_be_printed
